purpose: A held-out check of specialist selection after the rules were corrected against run 40503493185 on selection.v1.json. Not used to choose or tune any rule.
labeling: Labels were written by hand on 2026-10-27, after the diagnosis of run 40503493185 and by the same author who corrected the rules, but before any Jev or model request with these prompts; they are not changed after a run. Prompts are synthetic, distinct from selection.v1.json, and hold no personal data or credentials. Labels follow the documented policy: simple tasks, chat and single searches stay with the lead; a task is labeled for delegation only when it has a distinct piece of specialist work (research from external sources, a code change, an independent review, or building or running tests). Several keep-with-lead prompts are moderate but single-piece, to measure unnecessary delegation. `roles` lists every role set that counts as a correct plan, compared as unordered sets.

scoring.decision: A case's decision is correct when a plan was built exactly when `delegate` is true.
scoring.unnecessary_delegation: `delegate` is false and a plan was built.
scoring.missed_delegation: `delegate` is true and the lead kept the task.
scoring.roles: Among cases where both say delegate, the planned roles equal one of the `roles` sets.
scoring.failures: Any failed, missing or malformed response makes the run INCOMPLETE (jev-selection-guard.py); it is never scored as a decision.
scoring.reported_not_gating: Delegation precision and recall, exact role-set match over all 12 cases labeled for delegation, mean expected-role coverage, and which kind of rule kept each task with the lead. Reported with the result; the pass rule below alone decides PASSED.
